To delete all columns whose first-row header contains "/description", use this VBA macro: Sub DeleteDescriptionColumns()
    Dim col As Long
    For col = Cells(1, Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column To 1 Step -1
        If InStr(1, Cells(1, col).Value, "/description", vbTextCompare) > 0 Then
            Columns(col).Delete
        End If
    Next col
End Sub
It scans the header row from right to left (so deletions do not shift later columns), and removes any column whose header contains the substring "/description".
